assessmentDefinition: All six user conditions are evaluated per exact tested HP-chain profile. Equal-output algebraic/source aliases alone are not a numerical ambiguity; effective entity overrides and new untested profiles remain ambiguous. CONFIDENT is research scope only, not permission or code for static admission.

classes.confidenceScope: Tested profiles only; category names do not authorize other units.

classes.conditions: Exact man and mount→entity joins; no engine/articulation; N=U.
classes.confidenceScope: Tested profiles only; category names do not authorize other units.

classes.conditions: Exact man and mount→entity joins; no engine/articulation; N!=U.
classes.confidenceScope: Tested profiles only; category names do not authorize other units.

classes.conditions: Exact man and engine→battle_entity joins; mount/articulation empty; extra joined HP roles empty; observed class flags and engine type must agree.

classes.conditions: Exact man and engine→battle_entity joins; mount/articulation empty; vehicle branch remains scoped to tested N=G.
classes.confidenceScope: Tested profiles only; category names do not authorize other units.

classes.conditions: Exact man, mount→entity, engine→battle_entity and articulation→articulated_entity joins.
